alyssa: Heads-up — Velox customer reported a quality regression after we merged their LoRA into the base for deployment. Quick eval pack shows QA F1 dropped from 0.69 -> 0.62 after int4 quantization + merge. Any obvious suspects?

devin: thanks, can you paste the minimal eval output? numbers + which quant backend? :eyes:

alyssa: pasted results below (shortened):
```
model: velox_base + velox_lora (merged)
quant: int4 (sym, per-tensor)
qa_f1: 0.62
bleu: 0.78
perplexity: 12.4
latency_p95: 310ms
```

priya: first guess is tokenization/remap mismatch — did the LoRA training use a different special token set? That often shifts logits distribution post-merge. Check `tokenizer.special_tokens_map` and vocab offsets.

sam: also check merge alpha. If we merged with alpha=1.0 it can push out-of-range activations for int4 mapping. Try alpha=0.5 and re-run quick eval.

devin: +1 on alpha. Another possibility: our int4 implementation uses per-tensor scales; per-channel (per-row) quant would preserve more expressivity on adapters. If customer requires int4, try per-channel for critical layers (attn q/k/v or first linear).

alyssa: running a quick smoke now. Command I'm using: 
`./tools/run_quick_eval --model velox_merged_alpha0.5 --quant int4_pc --evalset velox_qa --save /tmp/velox_eval.json`

build-bot: automated smoke finished (summary):
- merged_alpha1.0 + int4_pt -> qa_f1 0.62
- merged_alpha0.5 + int4_pt -> qa_f1 0.66
- merged_alpha0.5 + int4_pc -> qa_f1 0.68
(internal note: pt = per-tensor, pc = per-channel)

priya: those deltas point at quantization granularity + alpha interacting. Also confirm tokenizer padding side; left-padding vs right-padding affects KV cache ordering when serving — can look like regression.

devin: another quick trick: during merge, preserve normalization params from base (layernorm/gamma) instead of taking adapter-proposed updates. Adapter merges sometimes nudge LN stats. Try `merge --preserve-ln` if available.

sam: FYI we saw similar with cust-lyra earlier where turning on per-channel for the first 2 FFN layers recovered ~0.03 F1. Might apply here.

alyssa: re-ran with alpha=0.6 + per-channel first-2-ffn, preserved LN. Results: qa_f1 0.69, p95 330ms. Looks promising but latency +20ms.

devin: nice. Can you push those artifacts to the eval bucket and attach diff of outputs vs baseline so we can run regression tests? Also add a prompt set for hallucination checks.

alyssa: uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/velox/1732509123/ — files: metrics.json, outputs.diff, toks_profile.json. Sharing link: https://s3.mock/velox/1732509123 (internal).

priya: I'll run tokenizer remap check and a small suite to confirm no token-id shifts. If OK, we can document recommended merge flags for Velox and add per-channel overrides in optimizer suggestions in Redwood Optimize.

sam: action items: alyssa -> generate final merge artifact (alpha=0.6 + per-channel first-2-ffn + preserve-ln) and handoff to eng-platform for staging deploy. priya -> tokenize sanity. devin -> add a short blurb to the internal merge playbook.

alyssa: sounds good — I'll aim to have artifact + checklist done by EOD. :thumbsup:

build-bot: reminder: schedule a canary with 5% traffic for 24h before full rollout (auto rule).

devin: thanks all — great triage. We'll capture this in the onboarding note for Velox so next time their adapter gets merged we default to the safer merge profile. :white_check_mark:
